title: Clip roots carry offsets (a crawl floats the pelvis .6 m)
summary: KK_Crawl_Loop at t 0 floats the pelvis .6 m; ClimbUp_1m makes a climber 25% short. Bodies skip the floating check: measure bone heights before trusting a clip.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: ?bones=1 + boneLog(S, figs) (module.recon.rig-pose): pelvis y vs floor y

doc.when: Before trusting any clip for a low or unusual pose.
doc.avoid: Judging a lying figure by eye from the shot's camera.

problem.symptom: A prone or crawling man hovers above the floor; a climber is too short.
problem.cause: The clip's root/hips carry vertical offsets or a crouch.
problem.fix: Measure bone positions; switch clips (Swim_Fwd_Loop for prone) or lower the group.
problem.detect: pelvis y - floor y > ~.25 for a prone figure.
